scientific.integrity: The result is an exact first-step support classification obtained directly from the printed AdaLomo row/column factorization and raw division. It is checked on both the original and current paper formulas and compared against the distinct safeguarded first-party implementation.
limitations: First step from zero factorized states.
Matrix parameters; vector special cases are not asserted.
The maintained first-party implementation uses positive squared-gradient flooring and inverse-square-root preconditioning, so the printed support singularity does not transfer to it.

title: AdaLomo's printed factorized update has a sharp row–column support singularity
